pinPolicy.note: Board-agnostic: per-board reservations are set in config.py at deployment time. The bridge never assumes a pin map it was not given.

notes: Describes the full hardware build; sys.hello/sys.info advertise only the runtime-supported subset (software mode omits adc.read and the buses). Unsupported requests fail with structured codes (INVALID_PIN, INVALID_PAYLOAD, UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY, BUS_ERROR, WATCH_TABLE_FULL, UNSUPPORTED_ACTION, ACTION_FAILED) instead of fabricated values. Requires the MicroPython `machine` module; CircuitPython is not supported. Not hardware-verified.
